Cadastral map showing householders' names. Relief shown by hachures. Note affixed to map at lower right: North-Brookfield (formerly the North Parish in Brookfield) was incorporated as a town in 1812. Population at the census in 1830 was 1,241. Copy imperfect: Darkened, stained, top and bottom margins cut off. Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image.
